Title: CYP2C9 metabolism
Description: Reports two distinct liabilities for cytochrome P450 2C9, whether a compound blocks the enzyme and whether the enzyme metabolises it. The distinction matters because 2C9 is polymorphic in humans, so clearance routed through it can vary widely between patients, while standard liver microsome assays report only total turnover. NCATS measured half-lives for 5,000 compounds against recombinant 2C9 and screened the same library in a luminescent inhibition assay, releasing those data through PubChem, and trained random forest ensembles that undersample the majority class.
Interpretation: Probability of CYP2C9 inhibition at under 10 uM and of clearance within a 30-minute half-life.
